name: canvas-forge
description: Raster drawing and painting for pen tablets.
author: Canvas Forge contributors

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.package:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:linux-dir: npm run build && electron-builder --linux dir --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:linux-deb: npm run build && electron-builder --linux deb --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:linux-appimage: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64 --publish never
